market_definition: Silicone Sealants comprises silicone-based sealant formulations used to seal joints, gaps and interfaces while accommodating movement and environmental exposure. The market covers uncured sealant products sold in cartridges, sausages, pails or bulk formats for construction, industrial and other applications. By Cure Chemistry • Acetoxy-Cure • Neutral-Cure • One-Component • Two-Component By Performance • General-Purpose • Weatherproofing • High-Temperature • Mold-Resistant By Form • Cartridge • Sausage • Pail / Bulk By Application • Glazing • Sanitary and Kitchen • Facade and Construction Joints • Industrial Sealing By End Use • Building and Construction • Automotive • Electronics • Industrial Equipment By Region • North America • Europe • Asia Pacific • Latin America • Middle East • Africa EXCLUDED from the market: Sealants based on polyurethane, acrylic, polysulfide or MS polymer; silicone adhesives sold primarily for bonding; silicone coatings and finished components. COMPANY TYPE IN THIS LIST - DISTRIBUTOR: a distributor, stockist or specialty reseller that buys these products from their makers and sells them to industrial, construction or trade customers. EXCLUDED companies: product and raw-material makers and their own sales subsidiaries; companies selling only the excluded products; service-only firms.
who_is_included: DISTRIBUTOR DEFINITION (physical goods market): a company whose PRIMARY business is buying in volume from manufacturers and reselling/distributing onward - wholesale, authorized, value-added or stocking distributor. EXCLUDED: channel partners, resellers, VARs, dealers, agents and brokers that do not stock or wholesale; manufacturers and OEMs (including a manufacturer's own sales subsidiary); system integrators; and pure service providers or consultancies. Continent / Geography = countries with a physical site (HQ, office, warehouse, plant). Operational Presence = every country the company does business in, which is WIDER.
